status: methodology clarification; frozen sources and numbers unchanged
thermal_state: Protocol limitation wording said observed thermal state. Workers actually recorded available memory, swap, process RSS and load average, not temperatures or thermal status. Thermal state was neither controlled nor logged.
confidence_intervals: Six sequential paired seed blocks on one shared machine; bootstrap intervals are descriptive conditional on these blocks and do not establish cross-machine performance.
timing_scope: External synchronized four-update loop includes state I/O, but excludes model/data loading, warmup, validation and checkpoint writes. No end-to-end job-time or energy claim.
